question.text: How many working days before the opening of an initial public offer must the floor price or price band be disclosed?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that the issuer must announce the floor price or price band at least 2 working days before the opening of the issue, giving investors time to evaluate pricing. The Trap: Candidates often confuse the price-band announcement timeline with other ICDR windows such as the 5-working-day or 3-working-day rules used elsewhere, but the floor-price/price-band announcement is specifically at least 2 working days before issue opening. Note: The 2-working-day rule applies to the disclosure of the floor price or price band ahead of the issue opening date.
